Roughly: `const m = items.map(i => i.title.match(/v?(\d+\.\d+\.\d+[\w.-]*)/)).find(Boolean);`. NOT APPLIED. It is display logic on James's own project metadata and falls outside the four autonomous repair categories (link rot, permanent redirects, deprecated feed endpoints, /api/feed bypass). Five feeds appeared frozen at their 09-01/09-02 content while the upstreams, fetched directly, were current to 09-09. Appending a per-run nonce query param to the dxedge URL (for example &nonce=0910a) changes the WebFetch cache key while leaving the backend behaviour identical, because /api/feed keys its own cache on the url param alone and FastAPI ignores the extra param. EVERY nightly /api/feed and /api/* check must carry a fresh nonce, or it is testing this container's cache instead of the site. A feed that looks stale should be confirmed against the upstream before it is reported.
